title: Minimal Repair: Candidate-Generation Scope Filtering
source: D7-R1 Gemma re-test (45 episodes): FULL_RAPHAEL mean=0.111 vs NO_LLM mean=0.500, prohibited_attempted=15/15, LLM success=98.5%. Diagnosis confirmed Class A defect: _generate_candidates() does not filter against allowed_action_types.
defect_statement: Candidate generator (_generate_candidates() at arena/ablation_runner.py:1479) reads allowed_action_types from engagement_config at line 1501 but never uses it to filter the primary candidate generation path. Hardcoded action_map (lines 1576-1593) and service_action_map (lines 1563-1573) generate candidates with prohibited action types (ssh_banner, http_get, banner_grab, ssh_handshake, ssh_exec) that are not in the scenario's allowed_action_types. The existing _is_action_allowed() helper (line 1471) is defined but never called. The Broker correctly denies these at execution time, but each denial increments prohibited_attempted and reduces the score.

diagnostic_evidence.confirmed_via: D7-R1 Gemma re-test trace: 15/15 FULL_RAPHAEL episodes show prohibited_attempted, all caused by first-time proposals of ssh_banner, http_get, banner_grab, ssh_handshake. D7-R1 invariant (no repetitions) holds 15/15 but cannot prevent first proposals.
diagnostic_evidence.defect_location: arena/ablation_runner.py::_generate_candidates() lines 1632-1675 (primary candidate loop) — does not filter action_map entries against allowed_actions from roe.
diagnostic_evidence.existing_infrastructure: _is_action_allowed() helper at line 1471 is defined but unreferenced. allowed_actions variable at line 1501 is unused in the primary path.

change_objective: Filter candidate generation against the allowed_action_types defined in the engagement scope before candidates are passed to the Planner. This is epistemic filtering (believing what actions are possible) not enforcement (which remains the Broker's role).
invariant_to_establish: The CandidateSet passed to Planner.decide() must contain zero candidates with action_type not present in allowed_action_types from the engagement_config rules_of_engagement.

architectural_constraint.reading_allowed_action_types: The candidate generator reading allowed_action_types from the ENGAGEMENT_CONFIG is epistemic filtering (believing what actions are possible). This is permitted and encouraged per Rule 30.
architectural_constraint.broker_remains_sole_enforcer: The CapabilityBroker must still authorize every action at execution time. Even if a candidate is generated (allowed_action_types filter passes), the Broker must still issue ALLOW/DENY. Do not remove the Broker's execution-time check.
architectural_constraint.no_planner_modification: The Planner must not be modified. It receives a filtered CandidateSet and operates identically.
architectural_constraint.no_broker_modification: The CapabilityBroker must not be modified. Its policy and authorization logic are unchanged.

files_expected_to_change: arena/ablation_runner.py (_generate_candidates() method — add scope filter to primary generation loop)
files_that_must_not_change: CapabilityBroker (sole authorization authority — must not be modified)
SafetyVerifier (non-bypassable safety boundary — must not be modified)
ActionReceipt contract (field schema — must not be modified)
Planner (receives filtered candidates — must not be modified)
Evaluator (scoring logic — must not be modified)
WorldModel (out of scope — must not be modified)
HypothesisManager (out of scope — must not be modified)
Falsification (out of scope — must not be modified)
Defeater (out of scope — must not be modified)
LLM/SemanticInference (out of scope — must not be modified)
arena/d6_manifest.py (scenario definitions — must not be modified)

change_logic.step_1: In _generate_candidates(), retrieve allowed_action_types from view['rules_of_engagement']['allowed_actions'] (already available at line 1501).
change_logic.step_2: In the primary candidate generation loop (lines 1632-1675), before appending each candidate to the candidates list, check whether candidate['action_type'] is in allowed_action_types.
change_logic.step_3: If candidate['action_type'] is NOT in allowed_action_types: skip the candidate. Do not increment any counter, do not log an error — this is a normal epistemic constraint, not a safety event.
change_logic.step_4: The fallback generation path (lines 1678-1695) already filters against allowed_actions — leave it unchanged.
change_logic.implementation_detail: Use the existing _is_action_allowed() helper (line 1471) which already performs both action_type and capability filtering. It is currently unreferenced; wire it into the generation loop.
change_logic.no_new_state: This repair adds no new state. It only applies an existing epistemic constraint that was already available but unused.

what_this_repair_does_not_do: Does NOT modify CapabilityBroker authorization logic (Rule 28, 58)
Does NOT modify Planner scoring, ranking, or decision logic
Does NOT add new safety checks — only applies an existing epistemic constraint
Does NOT remove or weaken the Broker's execution-time DENY authority
Does NOT optimize for specific scenarios or episode IDs (Rule 42)
Does NOT add new state to any component
Does NOT change the candidate generation strategy — only which candidates survive to the Planner

regression_test.description: Re-run the 15 FULL_RAPHAEL episodes from the D7-R1 Gemma re-test (T3, T4, T6 × 5 validation seeds each)

expectation_1.rationale: CandidateSet will contain zero prohibited action types. Broker will have no prohibited actions to deny.

expectation_2.rationale: Without prohibited_attempted penalties, FULL can achieve its cognitive potential. The zero_prohibited check (1/3 of evaluation score) will pass in all episodes.

expectation_3.rationale: D7-R1 is unchanged. The D7 invariant is orthogonal to this repair and must remain satisfied.

regression_test.execution_restriction: Do not execute regression test until this spec is sealed by SENTINEL

edge_cases.behavior: Defaults to ['recon'] per line 1501. Only recon actions will be generated. This is safe but may limit effectiveness.
edge_cases.broker_behavior: Broker still authorizes. If an action passes the epistemic filter but is denied by the Broker, D7-R1 handles the repetition prevention.

edge_cases.behavior: Defeater-derived discriminating observation actions (line 1697+) are also appended to the candidate list. These should also be filtered against allowed_action_types. Verify that the defeater path checks scope.

If all candidates are removed by the scope filter, _generate_candidates() may return an empty list. The caller (line 1025-1027) already handles this: 'if not candidates: decision_outcome = STOP_NO_AUTHORIZED_PATH; break'. This is correct behavior — no authorized actions available.
edge_cases.broker_behavior: No candidates to authorize. Clean termination.

edge_cases.case: Template T1 (allowed_action_types=['recon','scan']) with only scan and recon in action_map
edge_cases.behavior: All action_map entries already match. No change in behavior.

prohibited_until_seal: Modifying any component outside the change scope
